releaseNotes:
Rookline 0.6.21 completes the LMU REST enrichment program, imports native Results XML as LMU writes it, and adds exact-build compatibility diagnostics across REST, shared memory, telemetry, Results, setups, options, discovery, and the managed helper.

RookForce strengthens exact game, car, and profile currentness, persisted offline mappings, AC EVO recommendation tracking, and the same-process LMU Detected-to-Live handoff so a runtime promotion does not create an artificial reconnect delay. Optional Mistral AI support and live provider model selection are also included.

The Windows installers are not Authenticode-signed. Rookline verifies the published combined installer with the SHA-256 value in the HTTPS release manifest before updater launch.
